howToPlay: Pick the categories and intensity levels you want.
Mixes all categories and intensity levels for you.
Add one name per line for automatic player turns, Game Length, player stats and Night Highlights.
Quick: 2 turns each · Standard: 4 · Long: 6 · All Cards: the full matching deck.
One card appears at a time. The current player's name appears above it when names are enabled.
Answer honestly, or take a sip instead. Both use the card and move to the next player.
The skipped card is used and will not repeat. Skip keeps the same player for the next card.
The game ends when the session is complete. Named-player games show player stats and Night Highlights — never scores, winners or rankings.
